warm-charcoal.$description: Warm Charcoal — Primary action background (filled CTA buttons), high-prominence borders, dark surface bands, nav and footer text on light backgrounds

soft-black.$description: Soft Black — Body text, headings on light backgrounds, general borders, link text — the workhorse dark neutral

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark hero/footer bands, outlined action borders (ghost buttons on dark imagery)

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary surface for alternating sections, subtle background bands

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

gt-america-mono.$description: Body, nav labels, product names, prices, buttons, badges, footer links, captions — the structural typeface carrying all functional UI text

nimbus-sans-extended.$description: Display headings and section titles — dramatically wide tracking (0.10–0.15em at display sizes) creates architectural, label-like headlines that feel stamped rather than typeset

gtamericamonoregular.$description: GTAmericaMonoRegular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
